_comment: OPTIONAL VARIANT of vercel.json — not read by Vercel under this file name.
Use it if you want ONE public URL with no cross-origin calls at all: Vercel
serves the SPA and proxies /api to the Render web service, so the client can
keep its default relative base and you do NOT need VITE_API_BASE_URL.
How: RENDER_URL=https://<service>.onrender.com bash tools/vercel-config.sh
(that writes frontend/vercel.json with the /api rule in the right position),
or copy this file over frontend/vercel.json and replace RENDER_SERVICE_URL.
Rewrites are evaluated in array order, so the /api rule must stay ABOVE the SPA
fallback. Put it after, and every data call is answered with index.html: a 200
full of HTML, which the UI reports as 'Backend not reachable'.
Vercel resolves /api against project functions BEFORE rewrites, so keep no api/
directory inside the Vercel root directory (frontend/ has none).
UPLOAD CAVEAT, checked against this repo: api/routers/enterprise.py rejects
bodies over 12 MB with a 413, but Vercel enforces a 4.5 MB request-body cap
(413 FUNCTION_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE) that vercel.json cannot raise, plus a 10 s
function timeout on Hobby. Large PDFs proxied through this rewrite can therefore
fail at the edge before reaching Render. Do that one step from the Render origin
itself, or skip this file and use the single-origin Docker deploy in render.yaml,
where the only limit is the app's own 12 MB.
Cold starts: Render's Free plan spins down after 15 min idle, and the first
request through this proxy is the one that pays the ~1 min wake-up, which can
surface as a gateway timeout. Warm it by loading /api/health on the Render origin
first, then the Vercel URL.
